content.user_title: Improve AI Prompts With Context Engineering
content.value_statement: Long prompts can bury key instructions and reduce agent reliability. This skill helps Claude, Codex, and Claude Code create concise, structured prompts with clear context and constraints.
actual_capabilities: Explains context engineering principles for reducing low-value tokens.
Defines markdown sections for background, instructions, examples, and constraints.
Provides checklists for prompt clarity, structure, examples, and boundaries.
Guides creation of new prompts through a goal, structure, review, and test workflow.
Guides optimization of existing prompts with before and after comparison criteria.
Documents patterns for just-in-time context loading and sub-agent delegation.
limitations: Does not include executable tooling or automated prompt scoring.
Does not verify prompt quality against live model outputs by itself.
Assumes the user can supply domain goals, target audience, and success criteria.
Examples are general templates, not domain-specific prompt libraries.

use_cases.title: Create Agent Instructions
use_cases.description: Build concise prompts with sections for context, instructions, examples, and constraints.

use_cases.title: Improve Claude Code Workflows
use_cases.description: Refactor verbose agent instructions into direct, testable guidance for coding assistants.

use_cases.title: Review Team Prompt Standards
use_cases.description: Audit shared prompt documents for redundancy, vague language, and premature data loading.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Prompt
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a prompt for [task]. Include background, instructions, examples, and constraints. Use direct language and keep only essential context.

prompt_templates.title: Optimize an Existing Prompt
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this prompt: [paste prompt]. Remove redundant text, replace vague instructions with direct actions, and preserve all required outcomes.

prompt_templates.title: Design Agent Context
prompt_templates.prompt: Design context instructions for an AI agent that handles [workflow]. Define role, capabilities, available tools, workflow, output format, and constraints.

prompt_templates.title: Engineer Progressive Context
prompt_templates.prompt: Restructure this long context package for [agent]. Identify core instructions, move details to references, and define when to load them.

output_examples.input: A verbose support prompt with repeated policy text and unclear output rules.
output: A concise prompt organized into background, instructions, examples, and constraints.
A note explaining which redundant sections were removed.
A short checklist for testing responses.

output_examples.input: A developer wants Claude Code to follow team review standards.
output_examples.output: A structured instruction document with role, workflow, review criteria, and explicit boundaries for edits.

output_examples.input: An agent context file includes a full product catalog and many examples.
output_examples.output: A context plan that keeps identifiers in the prompt and loads detailed records only when needed.

best_practices: Start with the smallest useful context, then add evidence when the model needs it.
Use markdown headers to separate background, instructions, examples, and constraints.
Review prompts for vague wording, repeated guidance, and oversized examples.
anti_patterns: Do not include full data dumps when a reference or lookup can work.
Do not bury requirements in long paragraphs when a list is clearer.
Do not create overlapping tool descriptions that confuse the agent.

faq.question: Does this skill write prompts from scratch?
faq.answer: Yes. It guides prompt creation using goals, essential context, structured sections, examples, and constraints.

faq.question: Can it optimize prompts for Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. It can help make Claude Code instructions shorter, more direct, and easier to test.

faq.question: Does it run automated prompt tests?
faq.answer: No. It describes review and testing steps, but it does not execute model evaluations.

faq.question: What is context engineering?
faq.answer: It selects high-value information for the model while removing noise and unnecessary detail.

faq.question: Can teams use it for shared prompt standards?
faq.answer: Yes. The checklists and templates can support consistent prompt documents across projects.

faq.question: Does it require external tools?
faq.answer: No. The skill is markdown guidance. Users may still test prompts with their preferred models.
